verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that mailchimp.com serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent has an entry point. But its content reads as a generic 'Complete Web Content Analysis' rather than curated developer or API guidance. The .md probe of /developer/ returned 'Page Not Found', though it linked to a developer.md welcome page, which hints that markdown docs exist without proving coverage. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes developer/API docs, confirmed markdown versions of the API reference pages, first-party documentation of the agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
